svg.title: Planimulation workspace composition study
svg.desc: Proposed desktop interface inspired by Bruno, with layers on the left, an existing generated-world map in the center, an empty region inspector on the right, and a seasonal experiment dock below. This static design study is not the implemented application.
svg.text: Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom. Select a region to inspect.
Elevation-based land colors; initial water geometry.
Click the map to inspect its geography
and the factors used by the model.
Units and model scope stay visible.
Fixed geography. Finite mobile water. Prescribed monthly forcing.
Initialization creates a seasonal experiment for the accepted world.
Design study · existing map capture · proposed controls
